qa.question: If this card is a digivolution card, does the Digimon it's part of count towards this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: Yes, the Digimon this card is a digivolution card in counts towards the effect.

qa.question: This card is a digivolution card in one of my Digimon. An opponent's effect causes that Digimon and another one of my Digimon to reach 0 DP simultaneously. Does this card's inherited effect give the Digimon it's a part of +2000 DP, protecting it from being deleted?
qa.answer: No. The Digimon is reduced to 0 DP and deleted before this card's inherited effect activates.

qa.question: If the 3 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name and a Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
qa.answer: You can add one of the cards to your hand. As long as one of the Digimon cards revealed has either [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: What does this card's "can't reduce digivolution costs" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer:
It negates effects that read, "reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by X," like <Digisorption> and [BT3-103 Hidden Potential Discovered!].
Even if your opponent activates effects like these, it won't reduce the memory cost of their digivolutions. They have to pay the digivolution cost on the card in order to digivolve.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I activate <Digisorption> on a card in my hand, can I reduce digivolution costs with it?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use effects like [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s "digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of X, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements" effect?
qa.answer: Yes. [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s effect doesn't reduce digivolution costs--it allows you to ignore digivolution requirements and digivolve for a specific memory cost, so you can still activate it.

qa.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name and a Digimon card with <Blitz>, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
qa.answer: You can add a card to your hand. As long as one of the Digimon cards revealed has either [Shoutmon] in its name or <Blitz>, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect include 2 copies of [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX], can I add both copies to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX] has [Shoutmon] in its name, and it also has <Blitz>. The effect is looking for "1 Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with <Blitz>," which means you can add both to your hand.

qa.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: 1 card with [Shoutmon] in its name and 1 card with <Blitz>.

qa.question: Can I digivolve into this card from a [Shoutmon] in my breeding area?
qa.answer: No, you can't digivolve from a [Shoutmon] in your breeding area using this card's effect.

qa.question: Do I have to attack with <Blitz> to get <Security Attack +1> from this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No. As long as the Digimon this card is a digivolution card in has <Blitz>, it gains <Security Attack +1>, regardless of whether it attacks or not.

qa.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Shoutmon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: This card has 2 [When Digivolving] effects. If <Blitz> resolves first, does the other [When Digivolving] effect resolve after the attack ends?
qa.answer: No. If you activate <Blitz> first, after activating any [When Attacking] or [When one of your Digimon attacks] effects, you activate the other [When Digivolving] effect before the counter timing occurs.

qa.question: I attack with this Digimon, and use its [When Attacking] effect to trash a red Digimon card with 3000 DP in my hand to give this Digimon +3000 DP. If I use an effect to attack again in the same turn and use this card's effect to trash a red Digimon with 1000 DP in my hand, does this Digimon gain a total of +4000 DP? Or does it go from getting +3000 DP to just +1000 DP?
qa.answer: The effect persists during the same turn, so the Digimon gains a total of +4000 DP.

qa.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect include 2 copies of [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX], can I add both copies to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, [BT5-019 ShoutmonDX] has [Shoutmon] in its name, and it also has <Blitz>. The effect is looking for "1 Digimon card with [Shoutmon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with <Blitz>," which means you can add both to your hand.

qa.question: I digivolve a level 5 Digimon into this card. Can I place a red level 4 or lower Digimon card or level 7 Digimon card from my hand at the top of this card's digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a <De-Digivolve 1> effect, trashing this card. What happens to the Digimon?
qa.answer: It becomes a level 3 Digimon. The digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.

qa.question: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a <De-Digivolve 2> effect. What happens?
qa.answer: The <De-Digivolve> effect trashes this card, and the Digimon becomes a level 3 Digimon. <De-Digivolve> can't be used to trash any more cards once the Digimon it's targeting becomes level 3, and the effect ends. Any digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.

qa.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
qa.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

qa.answer: You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

qa.question: When I use this card's inherited effect to return an opponent's Digimon to its owner's hand, can I gain 1 memory?
qa.answer: No. When you return a Digimon to its owner's hand, the game doesn't treat the digivolution cards as being trashed, so you don't gain 1 memory.

qa.question: When I use this card's inherited effect to trash the digivolution cards of 2 of my opponent's Digimon at the same time, can I gain 2 memory?
qa.answer: No. Even if you trash the digivolution cards of 2 of your opponent's Digimon at the same time, you can only use this effect to gain 1 memory per turn.

qa.question: This Digimon gains <Blocker> by an effect. If I block with this Digimon in response to an opponent's attack, what happens?
qa.answer:
Battle occurs as normal.
This card's effect essentially means "this Digimon can't be chosen as a target of attack by your opponent," which means that if you block with this Digimon, the target of attack can still be switched to this Digimon.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use [BT4-090 Chaosmon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to attack it?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: I have this Digimon in play, unsuspended, when my opponent attacks with [BT4-075 Blastmon]. Can [Blastmon]'s effect be used to switch the target of attack to this Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it can. If your opponent uses [Blastmon]'s effect to switch the target of attack, a battle occurs as if this Digimon was attacked normally.

qa.question: I attack with this Digimon when my opponent has no Digimon in play with no digivolution cards. I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to trash the digivolution cards of an opponent's Digimon. If this results in my opponent having a Digimon card with no digivolution cards in play, can I activate <Jamming> on the same attack?
qa.answer: Yes. If this card's [When Attacking] effect results in an opponent's Digimon having no digivolution cards, this card gains <Jamming>.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has <Security Attack +1>, and flip over [BT1-101 Howling Crusher] from their security stack. If its [Security] effect results in the attacking Digimon having no digivolution cards, does the attack end immediately?
qa.answer: No. You've already declared the attack, so even if your attacking Digimon loses its digivolution card, [Hexeblaumon]'s effect doesn't end the attack midway.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon, which has <Security Attack +1>, and flip over a Digimon card with a [Security] effect during the first security check. If this results in a Digimon with no digivolution cards entering my opponent's battle area, does this Digimon gain <Jamming> starting with the next security check?
qa.answer: No. This card's [When Attacking] effect has already finished resolving. Even if a Digimon with no digivolution cards enters play afterwards, this card doesn't gain <Jamming>.

qa.answer: Up to 2 total yellow [Warrior] trait Digimon cards and yellow [Holy Warrior] trait Digimon cards.

qa.question: Does this card's effect count this Digimon itself?
qa.answer: Yes, it does. This Digimon counts toward this card's effect.

qa.question: I have 2 Digimon in play. Can I use this card's effect to give -1000 DP each to 2 of my opponent's Digimon?
qa.answer: No, you can't. The effect only targets 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

qa.question: After playing this Digimon, I play another Digimon during the same turn. Since I now have more Digimon in play, can I give my opponent's Digimon an additional -1000 DP?
qa.answer: No, you can't. The [On Play] effect has already finished activating.

qa.question: What does "Look at your security stack" mean, exactly?
qa.answer: It means you can look at all of the cards in your security stack, without revealing them to your opponent. When you choose a card in your security stack to add to your hand, reveal it to your opponent. The other cards should remain hidden.

qa.question: What happens if there are no cards in my security stack that can be added to my hand with this card?
qa.answer: <Security +1 (Deck)> doesn't occur. Shuffle your security stack, and the effect ends.

qa.question: I flip over an opponent's Security Digimon during a security check, and this card's inherited effect reduces its DP to 0. Is the Digimon deleted on the spot, without a battle?
qa.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon is reduced to 0 DP, it still battles with the Digimon performing the security check.

qa.question: This card's inherited effect reduces a Security Digimon's DP to 0, but it has a [Security] effect. What happens?
qa.answer: The [Security] effect activates normally.

qa.question: If a Security Digimon has its DP reduced by this card's inherited effect and is later played due to its [Security] effect, does it still have its DP reduced when it enters play?
qa.answer: No. It's no longer a Security Digimon once it enters play, so it doesn't have its DP reduced by this card's effect.

qa.question: My opponent moves a Digimon from their breeding area to their battle area during the breeding phase. Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates during the breeding phase.

qa.question: During a security check, my opponent's Security Digimon has its DP reduced to 0 by this card's [Your Turn] effect. Is the Security Digimon deleted on the spot, without a battle?
qa.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon is reduced to 0 DP, it still battles with the Digimon performing the security check.

qa.answer: No. It's no longer a Security Digimon once it enters play, so it doesn't have its DP reduced by this card's effect.

qa.question: What cards can be played using this card's [When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer: 1 yellow level 3 Digimon card or 1 yellow [Warrior] trait Digimon card.

qa.question: This card is being deleted. Can I use this card's effect to place it at the bottom of 1 of my green Digimon's digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: This card that was targeted by [BT11-043 KingSukamon]'s effect and had its name changed to [Sukamon] is deleted. If I have no other [Palmon] in the trash, can I place this same card at the bottom of the digivolution cards of one of my green Digimon from the trash with it's [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
The [On Deletion] effect is activated while treated as [Sukamon], but the name changing effect is lost when the card is deleted and placed in the trash, so you can treat this card as a [Palmon] card.

qa.question: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type and an [Arata Sanada] card, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
qa.answer: You can add a card to your hand. As long as one of the cards revealed is either a Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type or an [Arata Sanada] card, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: 1 [Unidentified] trait Digimon card and 1 [Arata Sanada].

qa.question: I use this card's [On Play] effect to check the top card of my deck. What happens to that card?
qa.answer: After checking the card, place it back on top of your deck face down.

qa.question: A Digimon has <Rush> thanks to this card's inherited effect. If that Digimon digivolves into a Digimon with a different name, can that Digimon attack the same turn it entered play?
qa.answer: No, it can't. The Digimon loses <Rush> when its name changes, so it can't attack.

qa.question: If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon, is it treated as a Security Digimon even in my battle area?
qa.answer: No, it's treated as a normal Digimon once it comes into play.

qa.question: Can I play this Digimon with its [Security] effect even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, regardless of the battle's outcome, you get to play this Digimon at the end of the battle.

qa.question: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Is this card played off its [Security] effect first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?
qa.answer: This Digimon is played after the battle with the attacking Digimon ends, and before the next check is performed.

qa.question: Can I digivolve into this card from a [Keramon] in my breeding area?
qa.answer: No, you can't digivolve from a [Keramon] in your breeding area using this card's effect.

qa.question: What's a token?
qa.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

qa.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Keramon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: This card's <Digi-Burst> effect reads, "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect..." How does this effect work, exactly?
qa.answer: "If no Digimon was deleted by this effect" refers to times where, when <Digi-Burst> is activated, your opponent doesn't have a Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less in play, or an effect makes it so that there are no Digimon you can delete. Essentially, it means there was no Digimon in play that could be deleted by "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less."

qa.question: If my opponent has a Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less in play, can I activate this card's <Digi-Burst> and choose not to delete my opponent's Digimon in order to trash the top card of their security stack?
qa.answer: No. If you use this card's <Digi-Burst> and your opponent has a Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less, you must target that Digimon when you activate the effect. If a valid target exists, you must choose it as part of the effect.

qa.question: My opponent has 2 Digimon in play with play costs of 6 or less. One of them has an effect that reads, "This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent's effects," while the other does not. If I activate this card's <Digi-Burst>, can I choose the Digimon that "can't be deleted by your opponent's effects" in order to trash the top card of my opponent's security stack?
qa.answer: Yes. Digimon with play costs of 6 or less are valid targets. If you choose it, the "can't be deleted by your opponent's effects" will prevent it from being deleted, allowing you to trash the top card of your opponent's security stack instead.

qa.question: This Digimon's DP is reduced to 0 by an opponent's effect. Does this card's [On Deletion] effect activate?
qa.answer: No. When a Digimon is deleted at 0 DP, it's deleted by the game rules, not a card effect, so the game doesn't treat it as if it was deleted by an effect.

qa.question: Can this card's effect be used to return a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] inherited effect from my trash to my hand?
qa.answer: No. This effect can't be used to return a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] inherited effect from your trash to your hand.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to play a card like [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], which has an effect that reads, "delete 1 of your other Digimon to..." Does deleting the purple Digimon for this card's effect cause the "delete 1 of your other Digimon" effect to activate?
qa.answer: No. Your purple Digimon has already been deleted when [ChaosGallantmon] enters play, so it doesn't activate.

qa.question: When this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect doesn't delete any of my opponent's Digimon, does the effect let it digivolve into [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], [BT9-017 Gallantmon (X Antibody)], or [EX2-073 Gallantmon Crimson Mode]?
qa.answer:
Digivolution into [BT9-017 Gallantmon (X Antibody)] is possible.
Digivolution into [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon] isn't possible because the digivolution requirements aren't met.
[EX2-073 Gallantmon Crimson Mode] is level 7, so digivolution isn't possible.

qa.question: If I have another Digimon in play, can I choose any one of this card's three effects?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I don't have another Digimon in play, what order do I activate this card's three effects in?
qa.answer: The owner of the card gets to decide the order they activate in.

qa.question: What's a token?
qa.answer: A token is a special card played from an effect that is treated as a Digimon or Tamer. This card's effect can play tokens treated as Digimon named "Diaboromon." For detailed rules pertaining to tokens, check the rule manual.

qa.question: Do Diaboromon tokens meet the white color requirement?
qa.answer: Yes, they do.

qa.question: When playing this card, can I delete one of my [Diaboromon] tokens to reduce its play cost by 12?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
qa.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving] effect" activate.

qa.question: I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack. Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

qa.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, it can't be activated.

qa.question: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect. Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't count.
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].

qa.question: When this card digivolves, can I activate <Blitz> first to attack, then use the "Unsuspend this Digimon" effect to unsuspend this Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes. If you activate <Blitz> first, you declare the attack and suspend the Digimon at that point in time. If you then activate the "Unsuspend this Digimon" effect, you can unsuspend this Digimon itself.

qa.question: When this Digimon is deleted, I activate this card's [All Turns] effect to have this Digimon remain in the battle area. Does this cause "When another Digimon is deleted" effects to activate?
qa.answer: No. This card's [All Turns] effect prevents other effects from deleting this Digimon or returning it to its owner's hand or deck, so it isn't treated as being deleted by the game rules.

qa.question: This [When Digivolving] effect plays up to 2 black and/or purple Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less from my trash. Can I play cards that weren't trashed using this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. Any cards in your trash that are black and/or purple Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less can be played.

qa.question: What cards can be played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Up to a total of 2 black Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less or purple Digimon cards with play costs of 8 or less.

qa.question: My opponent has a suspended Digimon with <Reboot>. Upon my turn, can I use this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect to gain 2 memory before that opponent Digimon unsuspends in the unsuspend phase?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
[Start of Your Turn] effects trigger and activate before cards are unsuspended for the unsuspend phase.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to reveal cards from my deck, but then choose to not digivolve?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve.
In such cases, you return all of the revealed cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

qa.question: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [Your Turn] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw and where do I draw from?
qa.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

qa.question: If I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the bottom of the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when I have 2 or fewer cards in my deck?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you reveal as many cards from your deck as possible.

qa.question: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area. Can I activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 2 copies of this card, reveal 6 cards from the top of my deck, and then digivolve my Digimon into a card among them?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
When your Digimon attacks, the [Your Turn] effects on the 2 copies of this card trigger simultaneously. Effects that trigger simultaneously can be activated 1 at a time, therefore you can activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card, and once all effects have been resolved, you can then activate the [Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card.

qa.question: When a green level 5 Digimon with a [When Attacking] effect attacks, in what order can this card's [Your Turn] effect and the attacking Digimon's [When Attacking] effect activate?
qa.answer:
The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
However, if this card's [Your Turn] effect is activated first and that Digimon digivolves, its [When Attacking] effect is considered to be lost and can no longer activate.

qa.question: My green Digimon that isn't level 5 attacks, and another effect digivolves it into a green level 5 Digimon. Can I then activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
This card's [Your Turn] effect triggers when a green level 5 Digimon attacks. It doesn't trigger when other Digimon attack, therefore it can't be activated.

qa.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also give "[When Attacking] Lose 1 memory" to my level 3 Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: If I have 2 copies of this Tamer in play and attack with a level 3 Digimon, do I lose 2 memory?
qa.answer: Yes. Each effect activates separately, resulting in you losing a total of 2 memory.

qa.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
qa.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon is played by an effect such as the effect on BT5-092 [Nokia Shiramine] or when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], [BT9-084 Tai Kamiya & Kari Kamiya], or [P-012 Tai Kamiya (V-Tamer)] is one of the cards revealed, can I add that card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, those are Tamer cards with [Tai Kamiya] in their names, so you can add one to your hand.

qa.question: Can I play cards that include [Tai Kamiya] in their names, like [BT5-093 Tai Kamiya & Matt Ishida], with this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No, this card's inherited effect can only play cards specifically named [Tai Kamiya].

qa.question: I have a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer card. Can I use this card's effect to place a red level 4 or lower Digimon card from my hand at the bottom of one of my Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer card?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to place a Digimon card under one of my Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer card. If <De-Digivolve> causes that card to become a Tamer card again, what happens to the digivolution cards under it?
qa.answer: It remains stacked on top of the digivolution cards, but since it's no longer a Digimon, it can no longer activate inherited effects. If it digivolves back into a Digimon, it will be able to use inherited effects again.

qa.question: When choosing which Digimon to trash a digivolution card from and which Digimon to return to its owner's deck with this card's effect, can I choose different cards for each one?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I have 2 Digimon in play, can I activate this card's effect to give an opponent's Digimon -3000 DP twice, for a total of -6000 DP?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If my opponent has a level 7 Digimon in play and I use this card when my opponent's security stack is empty, do I win the game?
qa.answer: No. There are no security cards to trash, but this doesn't allow you to win the game.

qa.question: My opponent activates this card's [Security] effect. If I then attack with a Digimon that has <Piercing> and delete an opponent's Digimon in battle, do I check my opponent's security cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it's possible to attack your opponent's Digimon, which means you can perform checks off of <Piercing>.

qa.question: My opponent doesn't have a Digimon I can target with <De-Digivolve 2> in play. Can I still use this card to create a [Diaboromon] token?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I only have a [Diaboromon] token in my battle area. Can I use this card to create a new [Diaboromon] token?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: My opponent doesn't have a Digimon I can target with <De-Digivolve 3> in play. Can I still use this card to delete all of my opponent's Digimon with play costs of 3 or less?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to play a card like [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], which has an effect that reads, "delete 1 of your other Digimon to..." Does deleting the purple Digimon for this card's effect cause the "delete 1 of your other Digimon" effect to activate?
qa.answer: No. Your purple Digimon has already been deleted when [ChaosGallantmon] enters play, so it doesn't activate.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's effect if my opponent doesn't have both an unsuspended level 4 and level 5 Digimon in play?
qa.answer: Yes. As long as your opponent has either an unsuspended level 4 or level 5 in Digimon in play, you can activate this card's effect.

qa.question: What cards are deleted by this card's [Main] effect?
qa.answer: 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 4 Digimon and 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 5 Digimon.

qa.question: After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my level 6 Digimon digivolving to level 7 when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGreymon], I use [BT5-109 Mega Digimon Fusion!] to digivolve it into a level 7 Digimon. At the end of the turn, which effect takes precedence: This card's "delete this Digimon at the end of the turn" effect, or [Mega Digimon Fusion!]'s "return the Digimon that digivolved with this effect to the bottom of its owner's deck" effect?
qa.answer: They both trigger at the same time, so you can choose which order to activate them in. The one you activate first takes precedence.

qa.question: After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGarurumon], I use [BT5-109 Mega Digimon Fusion!] to digivolve it into a level 7 Digimon. At the end of the turn, which effect takes precedence: This card's "delete this Digimon at the end of the turn" effect, or [Mega Digimon Fusion!]'s "return the Digimon that digivolved with this effect to the bottom of its owner's deck" effect?
qa.answer: They both trigger at the same time, so you can choose which order to activate them in. The one you activate first takes precedence.

qa.question: Does this card's effect delete all of my Digimon and Tamers, too?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: I have this card and BT19-053 [QueenBeemon] in the battle area. My opponent uses BT5-110 [All Delete] and I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon would leave the battle area at the same time, and this Digimon is prevented from leaving. What happens if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward?
qa.answer:
BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect places all of your Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait into your security stack.
In such cases, this card's [All Turns] effect prevents this Digimon from being deleted, but if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward, you can place all of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon that were affected by the deletion effect into your security stack.

qa.question: Can I digivolve a Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name in the breeding area into this card?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I use a "digivolve your Digimon" effect to digivolve my Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name in the battle area into this card in my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I trash just 1 digivolution card for the conditions of this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this [Opponent's Turn] effect require you to trash the specified number of digivolution cards.

qa.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
qa.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

qa.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
qa.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended.
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

qa.question: Do [End of Attack] effects activate if I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect and end the attack from an opponent's Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, they activate.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What does "without battling" in this card's [Security] effect mean?
qa.answer: If this card is flipped over as a Security Digimon, it's played in its owner's battle area without battling the attacking Digimon. Even if the attacking Digimon has lower DP than this card, no battle occurs, and the attacking Digimon is not deleted.

qa.question: This card is flipped over during a security check. If the attacking Digimon has extra security checks remaining from <Security Attack +>, what happens?
qa.answer: After playing this Digimon, the remaining checks are performed.

qa.question: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect be used to delete a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
qa.answer: No, it can't.

qa.question: My opponent only has 1 BT5-112 [Omnimon Zwart Defeat] in the battle area. If that BT5-112 [Omnimon Zwart Defeat] is deleted and this card is chosen as its [On Deletion] effect, is this card deleted?
qa.answer:
Yes, it's deleted.
If this card's [All Turns] effect activates while your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, as soon as that Digimon leaves, the effect will no longer be activated.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0228.title: <Digisorption>
comprehensive-0228.text:
16-10. <Digisorption>
16-10-1. <Digisorption> is a keyword effect. When a digivolution into a Digimon card with this effect in the hand would occur, by suspending 1 of your Digimon, the digivolution cost is reduced according to the value specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Digisorption -3>.
16-10-2. <Digisorption> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when a digivolution into a card with this effect in the hand would occur. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-10-3. "By suspending 1 of your Digimon" in <Digisorption> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "the digivolution cost is reduced" will be mandatory.
16-10-4. If 1 Digimon card has multiple instances of <Digisorption>, they overlap when they trigger.37 Multiple instances of <Digisorption> can be activated for a single digivolution.
16-10-5. <Digisorption> can be used to suspend a Digimon that will become a digivolution card.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0232.title: <Digi-Burst>
comprehensive-0232.text:
16-14. <Digi-Burst>
16-14-1. <Digi-Burst> is a keyword effect where another effect specified by this effect will activate by trashing the specified number of digivolution cards from the Digimon with this effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Digi-Burst 1>.
16-14-2. The processing from <Digi-Burst> is optional. For details, refer to 15-6 "Processing Conditions")

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.
